title: introduce-tool-contract-sandbox-and-authoring-runbook
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a lightweight interactive "Tool Contract Sandbox" authoring workspace and runbook to help engineers define, validate, and iterate on tool-call contracts for RAG/agent integrations. The sandbox includes a devcontainer, a local HTTP shim that simulates tool endpoints with contract schemas, TypeScript and Python sample adapters that implement the contract, an authoring UI that renders contract previews and example exchanges, CI smoke tests that validate contract conformance, and docs site updates with step-by-step runbook. Motivation: reduce friction when teams design tool contracts and structured outputs; provide a reproducible local workflow for authoring, testing, and onboarding. This PR bundles examples under examples/tool-contract-sandbox, a docs site section at docs/authoring/tool-contracts, and CI checks under .github/workflows/tool-contract-smoke.yml. Checklist: [x] devcontainer + local server [x] TS & Python adapter samples [x] contract schema + example exchanges [x] smoke CI + linting [x] docs runbook and API snippets [x] lightweight e2e via Playwright
